visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun wearing a red sweatshirt labeled 'MYSTERIC' sits in front of a plain beige wall, gesturing animatedly with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera. Behind her shoulder, a man with glasses and short black hair looks on, occasionally nodding or reacting. The lighting is bright and even, typical of indoor studio or home setups. (2) The scene transitions into a fast-paced montage of past life events: bright fireworks exploding against a dark night sky with crowd members visible in silhouette; a young boy with a noticeable stitched cut on his chin; the same boy playing energetically in a living room; a monochrome security camera recording of two people in bed reacting to a room shaking during an earthquake; a close-up of a pregnant woman's stomach; the young boy tenderly holding a newborn baby; and the woman in a pink shirt embracing and kissing both children. (3) The woman in the red sweatshirt is now in a kitchen setting, holding up rectangular white and green packages of 'Laurel' brand Tangyuan (glutinous rice balls). She points to the sesame and peanut flavor labels while smiling broadly. (4) A digital interface sequence appears, showing a cartoon train and a mobile website for 'Laurel Tangyuan Lucky Station,' followed by a shot of the woman and man in the kitchen using chopsticks to eat the white round tangyuan from small bowls, appearing satisfied and cheerful as they wrap up their story.

The BGM remains consistent but dips slightly in volume to provide room for vocal clarity. Occasional 'whoosh' transitions and simulated UI clicks are heard as the screen recording sequence plays. (3) The female speaker's tone becomes more promotional and direct, emphasizing specific keywords with higher vocal arousal. The male voice enters briefly with a supportive, calm conversational tone, creating a duo dynamic. Sound effects like a train whistle and festive chimes are introduced during the product interaction phase. The BGM reaches a slightly higher peak during the final brand slogan before fading out cleanly.
